I have a complete picture of the implementation. Let me finalize my assessment.

The implementation ("Stash") is a React SPA with localStorage persistence and a Vite dev-server middleware (`/api/metadata`) that fetches page metadata. Key model: bookmarks with url/title/domain/description/tags/collection/favorite/read. It has folders ("collections"), favorites, read-later, substring search, sort, and metadata auto-capture. It lacks: duplicate detection, tag autocomplete, tag-click filtering, boolean/#tag/phrase search, multi-select/bulk, markdown notes, snapshots, archive, bundles, Netscape import/export, and settings.
